{{Top|leg}}
'''Carbonyl''' was a type of substance that could be found on the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ostfrei]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] near to a [[Ostfrei pirate base|hidden pirate base]] that was in operation .<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?">{{LivingForce|Who Goes Thaere?}}</ref>
 
{{RPG|''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]''}}
Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of freelance agents]] investigating reports of suspicious activity on Ostfrei located the concealed [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base by using a portable [[chemical scanner]] to track a trail of carbonyl ions and ionized [[methyl]] that led to the pirate installation.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
{{Endgame}}
 
==Behind the scenes==
Carbonyl appeared in ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'' a roleplaying adventure by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] released in [[2003]] as an instalment in Year Three of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign. In roleplaying module, the players roleplay as the freelance agents dispatched to Ostfrei and it is possible for the player characters to find the concealed pirate base on the moon by following a trail of carbonyl ions.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
